title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.8
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- fix(agents)!: Enforce sandbox memory budgets with cgroups ([#3654](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3654) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Add GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6.1 Sol to catalog ([#3660](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3660) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Classify unreachable join failures as user errors ([#3580](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3580) )


## API


- feat(rbac): Add SCIM provisioning API ([#3530](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3530) )
- feat(rbac): Add SCIM data model ([#3659](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3659) )


## User interface


- feat(ui): Add SCIM organization settings ([#3531](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3531) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.7...1.1.0-alpha.8](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.7...1.1.0-alpha.8)
